title: G8 learned-term headroom
description: Per-family learned-term headroom probe derived by resecta_data.eval.headroom from the Swift harness's raw match scores. For each family it quantifies the suppressible false-positive mass above/below the balanced cutoff (raw and posterior) and the score gap between the FP and TP masses, gating whether a learned scoring term has headroom. The posterior mirrors the engine seam CalibratedScorer.posterior(raw, priorMean = max(prior, floor)) with empty priors. Dev/eval artifact: not installed to the Swift Resources path.

schema_version.description: Wire-format version. Bumped only on a breaking shape change.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

absorbing_state_floor.description: The prior floor applied at the posterior seam (priorMean with empty priors).

cutoff.description: The family's balanced cutoff, or null if the harness defined none for this kind.

fp_above_cutoff.description: FP-class rows (gt_class none|suppress) with raw >= cutoff. Zero when cutoff is null.

tp_above.description: Positive-class rows with raw >= cutoff. Zero when cutoff is null.

suppressible_fp_mass.description: FP-class rows currently clearing the cutoff (= fp_above_cutoff); the mass a learned term could remove.

score_gap.description: min(positive raw) - max(FP raw). Positive => raw-separable (clean headroom); negative => overlapping. Null when either class is empty.

cutoff_posterior.description: Posterior of the cutoff under the floor; null when cutoff is null.
